due.note: Payment described as shortly after midnight on the due calendar day.

reminder.note_zh: 每月 13 日清晨扣款；需提醒（可接行事曆或手機，此處僅紀錄）。

interest.note: Daily interest: round(balance * (annual_rate/365) * days); days = period_start to payment_date (exclusive start, inclusive end convention matches first period 2026-04-13 -> 2026-05-13 = 30 days).

rounding.note: After term_months, if model balance_end is below this TWD, liabilities use 0 for net worth (integer rounding vs bank core).
